Date: Sat, 15 May 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Activation matrix: ops sprint gate pass & fallback validation

Team —

We’re planning the private-deploy activation window for ACME on Tue 18 May. Before we flip traffic we need a concise gate pass and fallback validation matrix so both sides can act quickly if anything regresses. I’ve sketched the ask below — please review and confirm owners: 

- Network preflight (ACME): MTU alignment, VLAN tagging, BGP neighbor UP, route reflectors healthy. Owner: ACME ops
- Infra preflight (Redwood): node health, nvlink visibility, GPU pool reservations, KMS service reachable. Owner: Rafael
- Routing & ACLs: verify subnet ACLs, egress NAT, firewall rules for control-plane, port 5269 (example). Owner: Monica
- KV/prefix warming: run scripted prefix warmup for 24h, measure cold vs warm latency. Owner: Mateo
- Smoke tests: /healthz, tokenization check, simple generate (100 tokens), streaming handshake test. Pass criteria -> <200ms p50 token latency on warm run, no TLS errors. Owner: Irene
- Fallback plan: explicit step to shift to hosted region or dedicated pool, doced rollback triggers and who initiates. Owner: Rafael + ACME lead

Deliverables I need by EOD Mon: ACME confirmations on network items, the signed-off go/no-go checklist, and the exact rollback endpoint (URI or route) we will flip to if we abort. Attach any runbooks you want merged into the shared runbook.

Thanks — Rafael

--
Rafael Mendes
Partner Solutions, Redwood Inference

Thanks for the clear matrix. Attaching ACME's trimmed go-live checklist and the ACL snapshot export. We confirm the ACME-side network items:

- MTU aligned to 9000 across transit (verified)
- BGP sessions established to both RR: PRIMARY/SECONDARY, no flaps in last 72h
- Firewall rules pre-applied in staging and mirror queued for prod cutover

We propose the fallback to be: shift traffic to acme-fallback-1.redwood-edge (route-level shift) then to hosted-redwood-az1 as second fallback. Initiation: ACME ops (Sanjay) or Redwood on explicit teleconference agreement.

Date: Sun, 16 May 2027 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Activation matrix: ops sprint gate pass & fallback validation

Team —

We executed the staged smoke validation in staging and ran a short live dry-run in the ACME pre-prod mirror. Summary: 

- /healthz responses: all nodes returned 200; control-plane components at v1.12.4; avg response 42ms
- Tokenization check: token counts match upstream; no unexpected surrogate tokens
- Generate smoke (100 tokens): cold p50 token latency 980ms, warm p50 token latency 92ms — within our on-prem targets for warm state
- Streaming handshake: TLS renegotiation observed once during initial test; root cause = intermediate proxy with idle timeout of 30s. ACME ops to increase to 300s or set keepalive.
- KV warmup: prefix warming script ran for 18h; variety of keys primed; observed steady-state cache hit-rate of 86% after run

Recommendation: Gate PASS with the exception of the proxy idle timeout. Proposed mitigation: proceed with activation but set the first 60 minutes as a slow ramp (10% increments every 6 minutes) with a live war-room and rollback slot at 00:22 UTC if we see TLS errors >0.5% or token latency regressions >20% from baseline.

Attachments: smoke-results-summary.csv (short metrics)

If ACME ops confirm the proxy keepalive change, we can start the activation window at Tue 18 23:00 UTC. Please reply with explicit ACK for the slow-ramp plan.

Thanks,
Irene

--
Irene Choi
Sr. Production Engineer, Redwood Inference
